title: Eurostat euro-area HICP flash estimate, November 2026 — the last euro inflation print before the 12-17 ECB decision
source: EST: ECB statistical release calendar (ecb.europa.eu/press/calendars/statscal/ges/html/sthicp.en.html, fetched direct 2026-11-03) lists '01/12/2026 15:00 — Euro area seasonally adjusted HICP flash estimate — Nov-2026'. One primary; Eurostat's own 'next flash' sentence will be on the 11-04 or 11-18 release page, not yet read. Filed estimate per this lane's no-self-confirm limit. Checked 2026-11-03
notes: DISCOVERED during eurostat-hicp-final-2026-11-18's initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-11-03); 28 days out, inside the horizon (allImpactsWithinDays 30) — at the 10-20 flash sweep it was 41 days out and was named, not filed. It is the first euro inflation datum after the 10-29 ECB hold and the last before the 12-17 decision, and the first to print the November energy base (Brent fell from 117.64 to 104.43 on 11-03, Yahoo front-month). Impact LOW and symbols empty, deliberately: no house playbook is rates-keyed. It widens caution and licenses nothing.
